### PQB_T2_MSQ_01: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 2, select all anatomical sites lined by Simple Squamous Epithelium: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Endothelium of blood and lymph vessels
- [ ] B) Mesothelium of pleura and pericardium
- [ ] C) Parietal layer of Bowman's capsule
- [ ] D) Alveolar air sacs of lungs
- [ ] E) Thyroid gland follicles

> **✅ Answers:** A) Endothelium of blood and lymph vessels, B) Mesothelium of pleura and pericardium, C) Parietal layer of Bowman's capsule, D) Alveolar air sacs of lungs
> **Explanation:** Simple squamous lines endothelium, mesothelium, Bowman's capsule, and lung alveoli.

### PQB_T2_MSQ_02: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 2, select all anatomical locations lined by Simple Cuboidal Epithelium: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Thyroid gland follicles
- [ ] B) Salivary and pancreatic ducts
- [ ] C) Proximal Convoluted Tubule (PCT) of nephron
- [ ] D) Germinal surface of ovary
- [ ] E) Stomach mucosal lining

> **✅ Answers:** A) Thyroid gland follicles, B) Salivary and pancreatic ducts, C) Proximal Convoluted Tubule (PCT) of nephron, D) Germinal surface of ovary
> **Explanation:** Simple cuboidal lines thyroid follicles, gland ducts, renal PCT, and ovary surface.

### PQB_T2_MSQ_03: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 2, select all cell junction types connecting adjacent epithelial cells: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Tight junctions (Zona Occludens)
- [ ] B) Adherens junctions (Zona Adherens)
- [ ] C) Desmosomes (Macula Adherens)
- [ ] D) Gap junctions (Nexus)
- [ ] E) Synaptic terminal boutons

> **✅ Answers:** A) Tight junctions (Zona Occludens), B) Adherens junctions (Zona Adherens), C) Desmosomes (Macula Adherens), D) Gap junctions (Nexus)
> **Explanation:** Epithelial cell junctions include Tight, Adherens, Desmosomes, and Gap junctions.

### PQB_T2_MSQ_04: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 2, select all locations containing Non-Keratinized Stratified Squamous Epithelium: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Oral cavity mucosa
- [ ] B) Pharynx and Oesophagus
- [ ] C) Vagina and Anal canal
- [ ] D) Cornea of eye
- [ ] E) Dry outer epidermis of skin

> **✅ Answers:** A) Oral cavity mucosa, B) Pharynx and Oesophagus, C) Vagina and Anal canal, D) Cornea of eye
> **Explanation:** Non-keratinized stratified squamous lines moist surfaces: mouth, oesophagus, vagina, cornea.

### PQB_T2_MSQ_05: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 2, select all characteristics of Transitional Epithelium (Urothelium): (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Multilayered plastic compound epithelium
- [ ] B) Surface umbrella / pear-shaped cells
- [ ] C) High stretch capability without cell separation
- [ ] D) Lines urinary bladder, ureters, and renal pelvis
- [ ] E) Keratinized dead cell stratum corneum

> **✅ Answers:** A) Multilayered plastic compound epithelium, B) Surface umbrella / pear-shaped cells, C) High stretch capability without cell separation, D) Lines urinary bladder, ureters, and renal pelvis
> **Explanation:** Urothelium is a distensible compound epithelium with umbrella cells lining the urinary tract.

### PQB_T2_MSQ_06: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 2, select all specialized modifications of epithelial cell surface: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Microvilli forming brush border for absorption
- [ ] B) Motile Kino-cilia for fluid propulsion
- [ ] C) Non-motile Stereocilia in epididymis
- [ ] D) Keratin protein waterproofing layer
- [ ] E) Myosin thick filament cross-bridges

> **✅ Answers:** A) Microvilli forming brush border for absorption, B) Motile Kino-cilia for fluid propulsion, C) Non-motile Stereocilia in epididymis, D) Keratin protein waterproofing layer
> **Explanation:** Epithelial surface modifications include microvilli, motile cilia, stereocilia, and keratin.

### PQB_T2_MSQ_07: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 2, select all specialized glandular epithelial modes of secretion: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Merocrine / Eccrine (Exocytosis without cell loss)
- [ ] B) Apocrine (Apical cytoplasm loss e.g. mammary gland)
- [ ] C) Holocrine (Complete cell disintegration e.g. sebaceous gland)
- [ ] D) Endocrine (Ductless secretion into blood)
- [ ] E) Autocrine gap junction pulse

> **✅ Answers:** A) Merocrine / Eccrine (Exocytosis without cell loss), B) Apocrine (Apical cytoplasm loss e.g. mammary gland), C) Holocrine (Complete cell disintegration e.g. sebaceous gland), D) Endocrine (Ductless secretion into blood)
> **Explanation:** Glandular modes of secretion: Merocrine, Apocrine, Holocrine, and Endocrine.

### PQB_T2_MSQ_08: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 2, select all organs containing Pseudostratified Ciliated Columnar Epithelium: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Trachea
- [ ] B) Large bronchi
- [ ] C) Nasopharynx
- [ ] D) Auditory tube
- [ ] E) Renal PCT

> **✅ Answers:** A) Trachea, B) Large bronchi, C) Nasopharynx, D) Auditory tube
> **Explanation:** Pseudostratified ciliated columnar epithelium lines trachea, bronchi, nasopharynx, and auditory tube.

### PQB_T2_MSQ_09: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 2, select all locations containing Germinal Epithelium producing gametes: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Seminiferous tubules of testes
- [ ] B) Germinal layer of ovaries
- [ ] C) Thyroid follicles
- [ ] D) Salivary gland ducts
- [ ] E) Skin epidermis

> **✅ Answers:** A) Seminiferous tubules of testes, B) Germinal layer of ovaries
> **Explanation:** Germinal cuboidal epithelium lines seminiferous tubules and ovary surface for gametogenesis.

### PQB_T2_MSQ_10: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 2, select all functions of Gap Junctions (Nexus) between epithelial cells: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Intercellular passage of small ions (Ca2+, Na+)
- [ ] B) Passage of signaling second messengers (cAMP)
- [ ] C) Direct electrical and metabolic cell coupling
- [ ] D) Rapid cell-to-cell signal synchronization
- [ ] E) Mechanical anchoring of keratin intermediate filaments

> **✅ Answers:** A) Intercellular passage of small ions (Ca2+, Na+), B) Passage of signaling second messengers (cAMP), C) Direct electrical and metabolic cell coupling, D) Rapid cell-to-cell signal synchronization
> **Explanation:** Gap junctions allow passage of ions and second messengers for electrical/metabolic coupling. Desmosomes provide mechanical anchor.
